title: Dark mode for the owner UI
body:
Add a dark theme to the web app.

- Follow the operating system preference (prefers-color-scheme) by default.
- A toggle in the header switches between system, light and dark and is remembered in localStorage.
- All pages must keep a WCAG AA contrast ratio; add an automated contrast check for the board and the decisions page.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace-web
repos.description: Next.js app with Tailwind; unit tests with vitest, end-to-end tests with Playwright

requirements.title: Add a dark theme that follows prefers-color-scheme
Header toggle for system, light and dark stored in localStorage
Automated WCAG AA contrast check for the board and decisions pages
